name: fish
description: Custom FISH function for filtering. The function must accept exactly TWO arguments -- the position and the object pointer -- and return true/false. The symbol is passed bare, not as a quoted string.
examples:
fish define my_filter(pos, ptr)
    my_filter = pos->z > 0.0
end
notes: Not allowed in plot windows due to potential side effects

The symbol is NOT quoted: 'range fish "my_filter"' is rejected with "Bad conversion of parameter". Verified on live MPoint3D 9.7 (2026-09-14); this doc previously carried the quoted form as its only example.
A one-argument function is rejected with "FISH symbol used as a filter element must be a function accepting 2 arguments".
